description: This PHP class 'DataGroupHelper' facilitates reading permissions data from YAML files and inserting it into a database for an HRM system. It manages API, Data Group, and Screen permissions, including related entities like modules and user roles, via Doctrine DBAL.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing data permissions in the system, including reading configuration files and inserting records into the database.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permissions data from a YAML file and returns an array of Api DTO objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads DataGroup permissions from a YAML file and returns an array of DataGroup DTO objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads Screen permissions from a YAML file and returns an array of Screen DTO objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permissions and associated data into the database, linking API rights with modules and data groups.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts DataGroup permissions into the database.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts Screen permissions and links them with user roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a data group by its name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a screen by its module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the module ID based on the module name, uses caching.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the user role ID based on role name, uses caching.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a user role on a specific data group.
